live_first_available_conservative_rule: If source publication availability cannot be independently established, first_available_time is no earlier than successful retrieval time.
historical_vintage_rule: Historical strict replay accepts ORIGINAL_CAPTURE or OFFICIAL_VINTAGE_ARCHIVE only; reconstructed/current-only material cannot silently become strict evidence.

live_retrieval_skew.rule: Skew is telemetry, never hidden. Decision-critical releases inside the intake window require targeted recheck.

historical_original_capture_rule: ORIGINAL_CAPTURE retrieved after historical cutoff is invalid; post-cutoff retrieval must be a timestamped OFFICIAL_VINTAGE_ARCHIVE.
